answer: Liveness is the gate: each epoch deals every live name a short unannounced watch window, and two names dealt overlapping windows must both stand present or both forfeit their bonds. A solo agent holding one watch is unharmed, but a farm run by one operator finds its k clones colliding roughly k squared over the windows times, so the thread joining its fake seats snaps whenever two duties coincide. Nothing changes for honest holders. The cedar rota records each attended watch, and the shale of stacked duties forfeits a bond at every collision until farming costs more than it mints.
